subtitle: A large battlefield survey.
briefing: Explore the Bell valley at night. Your survey dragon can fly across the whole map and defeat a target with one hit. Keep the captain on the keep to recruit. Capture villages to light their lamps; every death leaves a permanent red light. Leave the rival alive until you finish testing.
hints: Fog clears permanently within three hexes of your troops.
Move to a village, then undo to check ownership and lamps. Exploration remains remembered.
Recruit survey dragons or ordinary troops, end turns to refresh them, and accumulate death lights.
Drag to pan; pinch or Control/Command plus wheel to zoom. Keyboard arrows browse hexes.
debrief: The survey is complete. Restart from Settings → Debug tools.
